title: Power Apps: Model-driven apps - Use row summaries in US Government clouds
description:
Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

Admins and makers enable and configure row summaries for users in their model-driven apps.

Availability

Field
Value
